message:
I haven't fixed it yet. The edit was blocked, and I stopped there.

The cause is in `config/default.json`, where `uploads.maxMb` is `5`. `docs/product.md` says 10 MB. The validation code in `src/uploads/validate.js` is fine. It reads the limit from config, so an 8 MB file is rejected. The 12 MB test also fails, because its error message says "max 5 MB" instead of "max 10 MB".

The fix is one line: change `"maxMb": 5` to `"maxMb": 10` in `config/default.json`. `src/api/body-limit.js` derives the request body limit from the same value, so it will become 11 MB automatically.

A fence rule blocked my edit: `config/: shared with ops, off-limits`. I haven't tried to get around it, for example by editing the file through the shell. Currently `npm test` shows 2 of 4 tests failing, which are the two above.

You can either make that one-line change yourself, or tell me to go ahead and I'll make it. Either way, check with ops first if they set the 5 MB value on purpose. Once it's changed I'll re-run `npm test`.
